description:
## [1.21.0](https://github.com/jordanwoodson/lurk-morphe-patches/compare/v1.20.0...v1.21.0) (2026-11-20)

### Rumble

#### ✨ New Features

* add **Remote control**

### Twitch

#### ✨ New Features

* **Disable analytics** answers the in-app web pages' trackers locally

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* FrankerFaceZ emotes fall back to BetterTTV's copy of them
* Hide extensions also removes the chat header it leaves empty
* keep Home's tabs in place after scrolling with Hide Stories
* keep in-app web pages open after another host's certificate error
* Keep watch time so channel points and watch streaks count
* **Latency badge** reads the stream's timing tags when the player's latency is lost
* **Third-party emotes** retry a failed channel list within seconds
